title: a HIT reaction: she is hurt but endures it, leaning on her staff
physics: A sharp impact, a recoil backwards with the knees bending (hair and coat follow late), a long endure phase leaning on the planted staff with her right hand on the wound, then a resolute recovery starting from the head. She never sits or kneels. Her height drops only 4-8%.
poses: Impact: the head snaps BACK sharply. Face: eyes squeezed shut in a '>  <' shape with the eyebrows slanting DOWN toward the nose, mouth OPEN in a short cry of pain 'ah!' (an open oval mouth, teeth NOT shown). Body jolts backward; the staff stays in the left hand planted on the ground.
Recoil 1: pushed back, knees bend, upper body leaning back, hair and coat whipping forward late; pained grimace, eyebrows knitted (not smiling).
Recoil 2: knees bent more, she plants the staff firmly and starts leaning on it.
Endure 1: leaning her weight on the staff (left hand), right hand with the book pressed on her side as if wounded, head down, eyes squeezed, painful grimace.
Endure 2: same endure pose, shoulders tense, breathing hard.
Endure 3: same endure pose, starting to push up.
Recover 1: the head lifts first, eyes open with a resolute look, knees still slightly bent.
Recover 2: back to the ready stance, determined face.
rules: 3/4 view facing RIGHT exactly like #1 in every frame. Body and face never turn toward the camera.

The caduceus staff with the blue cross orb is held in her LEFT hand (the far side, on the right of the image), exactly like #1. It moves only a little from one frame to the next. It never teleports and never changes hands unless written.
The white medical book stays in her RIGHT hand (near side) unless the frame says otherwise.

Keep every design element of #1 in every frame: white nurse cap with blue cross, very long wavy blonde hair with braids and blue ribbons, long white coat with blue lining and gold trim, brown belts with the medical bag and blue potion vials.
Both feet stay planted at exactly the same spot in every frame (no stepping, no sliding).
The staff foot stays on the ground at the same spot in every pose. It never leaves the ground or teleports.

Facial expression is PAIN and endurance in every frame: eyebrows slanting down toward the nose and knitted, a grimacing or crying-out mouth. The eyes are never '^ ^' arcs and the mouth never shows a toothy grin; it must never look like a smile or laughing. No blush. She never sits or kneels.
